title: Para Penjaga Kebon
intro: Di hiji kebon anu rimbun, hiji komunitas ngadamel sumpah anu khidmat. Tapi tekadna diuji nalika kahoyong ilahi campur tangan, ngarobah kabeungharanana janten tanah anu tandus.
clues: Urang dipaparin kebon anu subur, tapi urang janten adigung.
Kami ngadamel rencana pikeun panén tanpa ngabagikeun ka anu miskin.
Kami miang isuk-isuk kénéh, yakin kana rencana kami.
Tapi nalika kami sumping, kami mendakan kebon kami parantos ancur sapeuting.
Kami sadar kana kasalahan kami sareng mimiti silih salahkeun.
Tungtungna urang tobat, tapi palajaranana geus telat teuing.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
